definition: More than necessary and therefore unwanted or excessive.
author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quote: Being asked a favour by one who used many superfluous words, he said to him: “When you have another request to make, send someone else to make it.”
example_sentence: Half the buttons on the remote are superfluous.
